title: athyrium congruum
intro: Athyrium congruum, commonly known as the Lady fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. The Lady fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat inflammation, respiratory issues, and as a diuretic. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating fever and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium congruum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
